methods.name: PCU certified winding constraints

upstream_validation.paris4_adjacent_pairs: 99.62% certified precision at 70% coverage on 1,502 human adjacent-wrap pairs, per upstream README; operating tolerances were selected on that same set.
upstream_validation.paris4_fit_band_8400_9400: Upstream reports slips per wrap 20.3% -> 9.3% on 32 held-out human ladders; second seed 22.1% -> 8.8%.
upstream_validation.paris4_fit_band_11000_12000: Upstream reports no measurable gain: 30.6% -> 28.6%, difference CI includes zero.
upstream_validation.ph0826: Upstream reports 50.1% -> 36.3% disagreement with PCU's own gold ladders on 8 held-out slices, not human ground truth.

campaign_policy: Do not transfer the upstream precision number to PHerc0800/0813/1447.
Use PCU constraints only as optional fit inputs where target-local certificate coverage is adequate.
Never use PCU-derived held-out constraints as the sole geometry ground truth when the fit also consumes Lasagna/PCU information.
Pin upstream commit and preserve upstream license/attribution if code or derived assets are redistributed.
